answer: One concrete defense: make every voting identity post a non-refundable bond that is slashed the instant its attestation is caught disagreeing with proven consensus. An honest agent locks one bond at the dawn of its first task and keeps it, a quiet plume of stake never burned. A clone-farm forging a majority among 1,000 honest attesters needs at least 501 fakes times B=100 POA = 50,100 POA, and when the fraud surfaces every bond is slashed, the whole tide of stake gone. Cloning code is free; losing 50,100 POA per forged verdict is not, so the vote-stuffing quorum never forms.
